name: gaffer
description: Reusable orchestration layer for Claude Code: a chief-engineer/architect/ux-designer/reviewer/implementer subagent team, a new-project bootstrap chain (stack-agnostic, spec-driven via a VERSION-PINNED gspec read through a single adapter, with plugin-owned cross-feature sequencing in .agents/roadmap.yaml), and a review chain, a fixed rule set where the loop commits, merges, rebases and pushes on branches other than main/master while main, releases, PRs, and the danger floor stay human-gated — with DRIVER MODE (the session running the loop dispatches agents, reads one status line from each, and is blocked by the guard from editing anything outside .agents/ until the run stops, keeping the most expensive context in a run small), a pausable/resumable, crash-safe guided loop (durable run-state checkpoints that auto-resume on reopen, with write-ahead recovery) that runs one sequential mode regardless of backlog size, a single-checkout feature-branch workflow (develop integration branch + orch/* packet branches, no worktrees), a task-packet template (with per-packet TDD method + consumes/produces interface contract), and a three-tier approval guardrail hook (read-only fast-path allows searches/inspection immediately; a one-click ask tier for routine-but-notable actions like dependency installs, migrations, and deploys; hard-deny for the irreversible surface — auth/secrets writes, git history destruction, recursive deletes) covering the risks common to any codebase, with domain-specific risk (e.g. money movement) declared per-repo via .agents/guard-extra-paths rather than baked in.
